definitions.explanation: One's own will and wishes asserted against other people: the insistence on doing things one's own way. Almost always critical, and used mainly in a few set phrases such as {我|が}が{強|つよ}い, {我|が}を{通|とお}す and {我|が}を{張|は}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{我|が}が⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{我|が}を{張|は}って、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かない→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: He always insists on his own way and won't listen to other people's opinions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{言|い}い{出|だ}したら→言い出す：04593_iidasu⟧{我|が}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: Once my older brother says he'll do something, he's the type who insists on having his own way.

examples.japanese: {我|が}を{張|は}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{謝|あやま}ったら→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Once I stopped being stubborn and simply apologized, the two of us were soon back on good terms.

notes:
{我|が} is the self pushing against other people: one's own will, pride and wishes. It is almost always critical, and it appears mainly in a handful of set phrases.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {我|が}が⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: self-willed; headstrong (read ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つよい)
- {我|が}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ / {我|が}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{通|とお}す→押し通す：20718_oshitoosu⟧: to insist on having one's own way
- {我|が}を{張|は}る: to be stubborn; to refuse to give in
- {我|が}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧: to give in; to yield to others

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意地|いじ}→意地：01786_iji⟧: stubbornness rooted in pride; ⟦{意地|いじ}を{張|は}る→意地を張る：15442_ijiwoharu⟧ is close to {我|が}を{張|は}る
- ⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧: selfish; willful — the everyday word for someone who demands their own way
- ⟦{自我|じが}→自我：16132_jiga⟧: ego in the psychological sense, without criticism

WATCH OUT:
The same kanji is read われ in ⟦{我|われ}を{忘|わす}れる→我を忘れる：21217_warewowasureru⟧ (to forget oneself) and ⟦{我|われ}に{返|かえ}る→我に返る：17406_warenikaeru⟧ (to come to one's senses); see ⟦{我|われ}→我：30648_ware⟧. Do not confuse {我|が}が⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ with the literary prefix {我|わ}が〜 (my; our), as in ⟦{我|わ}が{家|や}→我が家：03038_wagaya⟧.
